entries.title: Ask HN: What game do you wish existed?
entries.author: jharohit
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What game do you wish existed?
entries.excerpt: I have usually kept a short list of games that would be fun if they existed. Long ago one my bullets in the list was a procedurally generated planet-sized planet with a full diaspora to explore. No Man's Sky fulfilled that for me. What are some games that you wish existed?
entries.guide_zh: 你一直希望有、市场上却还没有的游戏是什么样？

entries.title: Ask HN: Burnt-out, directionless but want to turn it around
entries.author: RoseBuckler
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Burnt-out, directionless but want to turn it around
entries.excerpt: I've been programming on and off since the age of 16. Unfortunately, I have never been a rockstar programmer. I've always pieced code together from multiple sources to create programs but I've always failed to come up with a solution from scratch of my own and provide any value. I've always wondered how other smart people are able to come up with libraries, services and various solutions from scratch. I've devised countless ideas only to never execute them for various reasons
entries.guide_zh: 长期编程却陷入倦怠与迷茫，发帖者希望找到重新振作的方向。

entries.title: Tell HN: I was permanently banned from eBay in one hour
entries.author: bannedfromebay
entries.current_title: Tell HN: I was permanently banned from eBay in one hour
entries.excerpt: I have some extra electronics around my house that I’d like to sell so I signed up for an eBay account. In one hour I posted 6 listings totaling less than 500GBP. I received an email that my account was suspended. I was told to call eBay. I have called twice and been told that I am banned from selling on eBay for life with no ability to appeal or hear the reason for my ban. I am not allowed to create a new account. On both phone calls I asked to speak to a supervisor. In both
entries.guide_zh: 只是想卖闲置电子产品，发帖者称注册 eBay 一小时内就遭永久封禁。

entries.title: Tell HN: The loneliness of a pretty good developer
entries.current_title: Tell HN: The loneliness of a pretty good developer
entries.excerpt: I'm a 10x developer and I hate it. If you consider yourself a "top" developer I would appreciate your perspective. It didn't start this way. I became a Jr Dev at 33 years old, people consistently assumed I was more experienced than I was. I'm not sure if it was my life experience or my relentless pursuit of self-improvement but I have been continuously improving my capabilities. Around the time I turned 38 years old I felt competent. My code started to become defect proof. Th
entries.guide_zh: 自认能力很强却感到孤独，开发者寻找其他高水平同行的相似体验。

entries.title: Tell HN: I made $1000 with my app and now making $500/mo

entries.guide_zh: 作者分享应用累计赚到一千美元、并开始每月收入五百美元的进展。

entries.title: Ask HN: How to learn math from zero for adults?
entries.author: stArrow
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How to learn math from zero for adults?

entries.title: Ask HN: Why can't I learn anymore?

entries.current_title: Ask HN: Why can't I learn anymore?

I make multiple 6 figures and by all accounts could be considered "successful". My most recent gig after working for years in React and Angular I've had to move to a new framework (Vue) due to project requirements that I did not write. As a senior contributor I'm expected to handle the complex stuff but
entries.guide_zh: 从业十五年后感觉再也学不进去，开发者探讨学习能力停滞的原因。
